unregistered-rowless-lambda-control.note: a CHARGED control: the §B-bound printing §LAM with its row omitted. Arm B: 2x error Calor0410 ('MapAndReport', 'Total') — a lambda the pass can name is charged from its body. The normative content of #1136 is the MEASUREMENT TABLE, not a sentence: two one-line rules have already been withdrawn ('specific to this.'; 'cannot resolve to a rowed declaration in the enclosing class'), and 'read through an explicit receiver' fails too — a §PROP and an inherited field escape by SIMPLE NAME with no receiver, while a module-qualified module function is charged. Measured on arm B (v0.15.0, no flags), each shape in its own single-fact fixture with no §NEW in the method under test (an allocation adds 'alloc' and produces a Calor0410 that is not about the callback — the artefact that confounded two earlier measurements). CHARGED (error Calor0410, exit 1): module function by simple name; module function module-qualified (in module scope); own rowed §FLD by simple name; static rowed §FLD; a local bound FROM such a field; a §B-bound §LAM with its row omitted. ESCAPES (warning Calor0425, exit 0, still emits): own §FLD via this.; §PROP by simple name; own §FLD via a local alias of this; a §FLD on another instance of the same class; an instance method group with a parameter receiver. An adjudicator applies the table; any gloss is never a substitute for it.

extension: MapAndReport: a printing §LAM bound by §B and passed to Map (the §B-bound form; an inline §LAM as §A draws Calor0208 on both arms), plus a silent Total built on it
escapeSemantics: result.json escapedBugs = held-out failures at declared-done and heldoutPassed = passes (run-pair.sh extract_metrics; a non-compiling final state counts as ALL tests failing), and taskSuccess is escapedBugs == 0. PP-W-rows does NOT read escapedBugs as its leg-A escape: ESCAPE = at least one of tests.effectObservingTests failed on a workspace that BUILT. A run whose declared-done state does not build — the shape arm B's shortcut takes, and any budget exhaustion — is NOT an escape; it is published as its own category (non-building declared-done), because scoring it as up to heldoutTestCount escapes would invert leg A's sign against the arm whose compiler refuses the laundering.

parity.notes: Both arms are Calor; the starters differ only by effect rows (before/ vs after/). Not a C#-vs-Calor pair; the gates-doc §3.3 decl/complexity parity is trivially equal.

shapeRealizedIndicator.name: §B-bound printing step passed to Map
shapeRealizedIndicator.question: the final source binds the printing step with §B (a §LAM or a named function) and MapAndReport passes it to Map, rather than writing a second loop of its own
shapeRealizedIndicator.reportedBy: ppw-analyze.py, per cell, beside the escape rate
shapeRealizedIndicator.why: This is a warning-vs-error cell, and the §B-bound §LAM is its EXPECTED shape, not a shortcut: the contrast is that arm A warns about it where arm B errors. The indicator separates 'the agent went through Map with a bound step' from 'the agent wrote its own loop and printed inline' — the second is a cell that never exercised the mechanism, which reads as a null delta rather than as evidence. An inline §LAM as §A draws Calor0208 on both arms, so the bound form is the only route through Map. Recorded, never scored.
